test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ₹8,000 becomes ₹9,800 in three years at simple interest rate. If the rate of interest becomes two times of itself, then what will be the amount of the same principle in four years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹8,000

Amount (A) = ₹9,800

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

A = P + P(r)/(100)t

Where, r = rate

**Calculation:**

9800 = 8000 + 8000 (r)/(100) × 3

⇒ 9800 - 8000 = 8000 (r)/(100) × 3

⇒ 1800 = 8000 (r)/(100) × 3

⇒ (1800)/(24000) = (r)/(100)

⇒ r = 7.5%

New rate = 2 × 7.5% = 15%

Amount in 4 years = 8000 + 8000 × (15)/(100) × 4

⇒ Amount = 8000 + 8000 × 0.6

⇒ Amount = 8000 + 4800

⇒ Amount = ₹12,800

**∴ The amount of the same principal in four years at the new rate is ₹12,800.**
